item.title: Did French President Macron Blame Indian Air Force For ‘Billion Dollar Rafale Market Loss’?
item.description: The claims that French President Macron blamed the Indian Air Force for massive loss in stock market value of Rafale’s manufacturer Dassault Aviation is false as we found the video to be doctored.

item.title: Did Manipur Declare Freedom from India? Here’s The Truth Behind Viral Clip
item.description: The footage dates back to 2019 and is connected to the announcement of a so-called “government in exile” by separatist leaders in London at that time. It has no link to the current situation in Manipur.

item.title: Viral Video Of Thar Hanging From NH-48 Signboard Is AI-Generated, Not Real Accident

item.title: Indian Army Camp In Rajouri Attacked? No, Old Clips Viral With False Claim

item.title: Did Canada Put Up Posters Telling Indians Not To Defecate In Public?
item.description: There is no evidence that Canadian municipalities have put up Hindi posters targeting Indians regarding open defecation. The viral image was found to be manipulated.

item.title: No, This Old Photo Does Not Show Sonia Gandhi Dancing In A Bar
item.description: The viral photograph does not show Sonia Gandhi. It is a 1967 image of go-go dancers performing at a hotel in Auburn, Sydney, during a brewery workers’ strike that caused a beer shortage.
